title: Pale Disease
description: A datapack that adds a new disease, that you can get from creaking
body:
_**This datapack adds more horror to pale garden by introducing a new disease!**_

![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cce517f8a60b42e376820c62b5f8fa8bbee668df.png)

How to get the disease? Just get hit by creaking and you will get "Pale disease" effect

![effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/922df2f57a09da62d577aa849038b8e74142afc4.jpeg)

What does the disease do? **Disease has 2 stages**, on the first stage you get the effect itself and **infinite darkness**. But on the second stage you get not only darkness, _**but also hunger, speed and strength**_ (imagine you become a creaking)

But how to get rid of disease? You need to craft a **_Resine vaccine_** ![effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/wMNXgcuG/images/67fb9e9c447f5a89bf340a00372998388e4a1db3.jpeg)

**And don't worry, you can't get pale disease twice**
